## Project status

The supported project documentation is [`README.md`](README.md). The current
workflow is Python-first and focuses on comparing DIA-MS2 spectra extracted at
supplied `Peak1`/`Peak2` retention times.

The files under `R/` are retained only for compatibility with the original
package. They do not implement the current DIA-window provenance, independent
MS2 diagnostic statuses, or SVG/PNG review workflow. Do not use the historical
machine-specific installation paths from earlier versions of this file.

Use the supported CLI from the repository root:

```text
python -m MSAI.python.cli.ms2 --help
```

Scientific definitions, current commands, output locations, and validation
boundaries are maintained in `README.md` and `docs/`.
